# 0.36.6
- Add “Resume here…” to the session header, Session Info, and session menu for conversations reported as open elsewhere or with uncertain status. - Require confirmation before opening a second client. The original process is not stopped; both clients may modify the same files or conversation if it remains alive. The agent CLI may reject concurrent access. - Reuse an existing RunHuddle terminal when that conversation is already open here.
Build and 103 Swift tests passed, including the external-session confirmation policy. Recovery on the affected laptop still needs verification.
Corresponding source, including pinned Swift package dependency sources and build scripts, is provided in `RunHuddle-0.36.6-source.tar.gz` alongside this installer. See docs/BUILDING.md and docs/LICENSING.md in that archive.
